# The window in winter

- Author: Rowan
- Published: 2020\-01\-12
- Event: 2020\-01\-12
- Recorded: Unknown

Original locator: move\-post\-03

Exact source text (untrusted):

```text
I returned the folding table to Kit in December for their aunt. A small secondhand desk fits beneath the window now. The paper flowers have faded, but I still keep them in the yellow mug. I like the room better in the morning than at night.
```
